sections.title: CNTRL/ERN TX EWD TO GA
sections.text: 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS SHOWED THAT AN EML/STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS IN PLACE ACROSS A MOIST WARM SECTOR CHARACTERIZED BY BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S. DAYTIME HEATING ALONG THE SRN FRINGE OF CONVECTIVE DEBRIS ASSOCIATED WITH NOCTURNAL TSTM ACTIVITY SHOULD ALLOW TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE 80S AND 90S. WHEN COUPLED WITH THE HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES...AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE VALUES INCREASING TO 2000-4000 J/KG. sections.title: NORTHEAST/MID ATLANTIC
sections.text: SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED CORRIDOR OF 12-HR HEIGHT FALLS EXCEEDING 100-150 M AT 500 MB WILL TRANSLATE FROM THE GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY NEWD THROUGH NEW ENGLAND AND THE ST. LAWRENCE VALLEY TODAY. ASSOCIATED SURFACE LOW OVER SWRN ONTARIO AS OF 16Z WILL CONCURRENTLY DEVELOP NEWD INTO FAR SRN QUEBEC BY 21/00Z WITH TRAILING COLD FRONT MOVING INTO THE HUDSON AND DE RIVER VALLEYS BY THIS TIME. WARM FRONT IS EXPECTED TO LIFT NWD THROUGH AT LEAST THE LOWER HUDSON VALLEY BY LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. MORNING VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT ACROSS NY/PA WHICH SHOULD ALLOW FOR STRONGER DIABATIC HEATING. WHEN COUPLED WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S...EXPECT AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF 500-1000 J/KG. LATEST MESOSCALE AND CONVECTION-ALLOWING MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGEST THAT WEAK CONVERGENCE ALONG THE COLD FRONT MAY LIMIT STORM COVERAGE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. GIVEN THE STRONG WLY WIND FIELD IN PLACE...ANY STORMS THAT CAN DEVELOP WILL BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO.

sections.title: OK
sections.text: THE DEVELOPMENT OF A NOCTURNAL LLJ WILL SERVE TO ENHANCE LIFT AND MOISTURE FLUX TO THE N OF SURFACE FRONT OVERNIGHT WITHIN A STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT...SUPPORTING MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG. ANY TSTMS THAT CAN DEVELOP WITHIN STRENGTHENING WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT REGIME WILL BE CAPABLE OF HAIL...SOME OF WHICH MAY EXCEED SEVERE CRITERIA. ..MEAD/SMITH.. 04/20/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM SWRN TX TO NRN GA
sections.text: LATEST CONVECTIVE TRENDS HAVE NECESSITATED CHANGES TO PORTIONS OF THE SLIGHT RISK ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY. OVER THE LAST HOUR IT HAS BECOME APPARENT THAT LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION ACROSS THE ARKLATEX WILL DRIVE AN UPWARD EVOLVING MCS NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT. NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS...MOST PRODUCING HAIL...HAVE EVOLVED OVER AR AND THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD/DEVELOP EWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS. FARTHER SW ACROSS THE HILL COUNTRY/EDWARDS PLATEAU OF TX...VERY STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO RECENT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT NW OF JCT WHERE TEMPERATURES HAVE SOARED INTO THE MID 90S. HAVE EXPANDED THE SLIGHT RISK A BIT TO ACCOMMODATE A POSSIBLE WWD EVOLUTION AS THE DRYLINE RETREATS. ADDITIONALLY...HAVE INCREASED HAIL PROBABILITIES TO ACCOUNT FOR THE LIKELIHOOD THAT MORE NUMEROUS STORMS WILL DEVELOP ACROSS THIS REGION. WEAK INSTABILITY ACROSS UPDATE NY WARRANTS A DECREASE IN PROBABILITIES FOR DAMAGING WIND...ESPECIALLY ACROSS THE HUDSON VALLEY WHERE TEMPERATURES REMAIN IN THE 40S. OTHERWISE...SHOWERS ARE INCREASING ALONG THE COLD FRONT OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF CNTRL PA AND THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE AS IT SPREADS TOWARD ERN PA/NJ LATE THIS AFTERNOON. ..D

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS CENTRAL/SW TX
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... PRONOUNCED NRN-STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGHS ARE FCST TO MOVE SEWD OVER COASTAL WA...AND EWD ACROSS LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION. BROAD FETCH OF MID-UPPER LEVEL WSWLYS WITH VERY MINOR/EMBEDDED PERTURBATIONS WILL PERSIST FROM SRN CA ACROSS MID MS VALLEY. AT SFC...WAVY/QUASISTATIONARY FRONT WAS ANALYZED FROM ERN TN WSWWD ACROSS NWRN AL...N-CENTRAL MS...LA/AR BORDER AREA...CENTRAL TX...SERN CORNER OF TX/NM BORDER...TO E-CENTRAL NM. FRONTAL ZONE...WHICH IS INTERRUPTED LOCALLY BY MCS ACTIVITY OVER MS AND W-CENTRAL TX -- IS FCST TO DRIFT SWD ACROSS TN VALLEY REGION...AND TO BEGIN DRIFTING NWD OVER CENTRAL TX AFTER ABOUT 09Z.

sections.title: EVENING -- ARKLATEX...LOWER MS VALLEY TO GA
sections.text: IN SHORT TERM...CLUSTERS CONTAINING NUMEROUS TSTMS -- SOME SVR WITH PREDOMINANT LARGE HAIL RISK -- WILL DEVELOP/MOVE EWD ON EITHER SIDE OF FRONT. REF SPC WWS 170...173 AND ATTENDANT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR SHORT-TERM SVR THREAT. AS SCHEDULED 07Z WW 173 EXPIRATION TIME APCHS...OVERALL SVR POTENTIAL E OF MS RIVER SHOULD DECREASE CONSIDERABLY. ALREADY WEAK LOW-LEVEL WINDS WILL DIMINISH FURTHER...AND 850-MB WINDS VEER...CONTRIBUTING TO REDUCTION ON STRENGTH OF LOW-LEVEL WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT. MEANWHILE...EXPANSIVE COVERAGE OF STABILIZING CONVECTIVE EFFECTS ALSO WILL ACT TO REDUCE SVR POTENTIAL.

sections.title: CENTRAL/SW TX
sections.text: SVR/SUPERCELLULAR TSTMS OF BOTH LEFT- AND RIGHT-MOVING VARIETIES PERSIST OVER PORTIONS OF THIS REGION. REF WW 171 AND LATEST ACCOMPANYING MESOSCALE DISCUSSION FOR NEAR-TERM FCST GUIDANCE. OVERALL TSTM COVERAGE AND SVR THREAT WILL DIMINISH AFTER ABOUT 03Z FROM COMBINATION OF: 1. CONVECTIVE/OUTFLOW STABILIZATION OF AIR MASS AND 2. LOSS OF SFC DIABATIC HEATING...LEADING TO STRENGTHENING MLCINH PER MODIFIED 00Z DRT RAOB.

sections.title: OVERNIGHT/MORNING -- SRN PLAINS TO AR
sections.text: TSTMS FCST TO DEVELOP OVER PORTIONS N TX...OK AND/OR AR IN BROAD REGIME OF STG ISENTROPIC LIFT...AS WAA AND RELATED LLJ STRENGTHEN AFTER 03Z. STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH ELEVATED MIXED-LAYER AIR...ALONG WITH MOISTURE ADVECTION/TRANSPORT...WILL YIELD 1000-2000 J/KG MUCAPE AMIDST FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR A FEW BETTER-ORGANIZED TSTMS TO PRODUCE SVR HAIL. ..EDWARDS.. 04/21/2011
